scope.reference: the retained independent real-package source render for the exact cell
scope.candidates: the retained v2 opaque candidate bytes, measured without recipe/legacy identity

claims.deterministicVisualFidelity: Source-relative geometry and pixel/ink error over the exact 128 independent references.
claims.structuralSemanticUsability: Image-independent DOM, ARIA, state, role, Web Component parity, accounting, fixed-point, determinism, and no-source-branch assertions.
claims.humanRecognisability: Pending final independent designer review. Deterministic progression never supplies this claim.

imageNormalization.alphaPolicy: Composite every source pixel over opaque white before ink detection or comparison; output alpha is 255.
imageNormalization.contentBox: Bounding box of pixels with any composited sRGB channel below 250. Blank images have no content box and fail.
imageNormalization.alignment: Trim to each image content box, center-pad onto the union canvas with white, never crop-to-match beyond content trim, resample, scale, or translate by implementation identity.
imageNormalization.inkThreshold: A composited pixel is ink when any sRGB channel is below 250.

geometry: signed and absolute rendered width delta
signed and absolute rendered height delta
signed and absolute retained CSS content-box width delta
signed and absolute retained CSS content-box height delta
cellMetrics.geometryError: Arithmetic mean of the four absolute deltas normalized by the corresponding nonzero reference dimension.
pixelRaster: exact differing pixels and normalized exact difference
threshold-0.1 differing pixels and normalized perceptual difference
ink: absolute ink-count delta normalized by the nonzero reference ink count

pixelInkComposite.rule: Weights are fixed and sum to one. Geometry is excluded so pixel/ink and geometry must win independently.

overallWeightedError.rule: Reported in addition to, never instead of, separate geometry and pixel/ink gates.

cellMetrics.tieRule: Two candidate errors tie only when their IEEE-754 numeric values are exactly equal; no result-dependent epsilon is introduced.

perCell: one unique matrix cell, reference, and candidate
exactly one label, one input, and one message
zero or two adornments exactly as declared
placeholder/value, required, disabled, error, described-by, and focus-visible state match the declared cell
global: all 128 cells and every locked axis value are present
React/Web Component parity is 128/128 for nonzero, threshold-0.1 pixels, geometry, and semantic probes
both sources have nonzero acquisition facts and parameter fields with zero failures
both source recipes pass two-cycle canonical fixed point and byte-identical repeated emission
all 256 corrected recipe API/ARIA/event assertions passed
no source identity occurs in generic recipe/compiler/emitter logic
offline accounting has zero silent loss
structuralAssertions.catastrophicRegression: Any recipe per-cell structural/state failure where legacy passes, any missing required cell/axis/state/role, any zero-pixel recipe cell, or any failed global assertion.

aggregation.cellWeight: Every one of the 128 cells has equal weight; hidden duplicates and controls have zero final weight.

antiGaming.implementationBlindMeasurement: The metric function receives decoded bytes, retained dimensions, and opaque candidate IDs only. It has no recipe/legacy parameter and contains no source-library or implementation branch.
antiGaming.identityTiming: Candidate identity is used only after all per-candidate metrics are computed and serialized in opaque-ID order.
requiredSelfTests: hidden byte-identical candidates produce exactly identical metric JSON
same bytes produce exactly identical metrics on repeated measurement
zero-alpha and all-white blank candidates fail nonzero/content-box checks
a copied reference is rejected by provenance even with zero visual error
changed metric weights or thresholds fail the protocol/tamper gate
antiGaming.thresholdSelection: No threshold or weight may be selected, changed, or waived after candidate results are read.

decision.engineeringMayProceedWhen: Both deterministic visual fidelity and structural/semantic correctness pass every locked relative progression criterion.
decision.engineeringMustStopWhen: Either deterministic claim fails; report the next implementation correction.
decision.humanDesignerGate: required before release and before claiming absolute Input/Field recognisability
